title: Accessibility infrastructure & VPAT readiness: tokens, components, keyboard nav
creator: Anika Patel
description: Run a focused accessibility audit across design system primitives and composed components (tokens, buttons, tables, charts) and deliver fixes plus VPAT artifacts. Goals: ensure ARIA semantics and keyboard navigation are consistent, color tokens meet WCAG AA contrast thresholds, charts expose programmatic descriptions, and produce a draft VPAT for Legal/Compliance review.
acceptance_criteria: All primary tokens mapped to semantic tokens and verified for WCAG AA contrast at 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text
Buttons have explicit ARIA roles where needed, correct keyboard focus order, visible focus ring meeting contrast requirements, and accessible name coverage for icon-only buttons
Tables include proper scope/role attributes, keyboard row selection navigable with arrow keys, and screen reader announcements for sort state using aria-sort
Charts expose aria-describedby/aria-labelledby, a programmatic CSV download link, and textual summaries for each chart at initial render and after interaction
A VPAT draft (WCAG 2.1 AA + WCAG 2.2 checklist) is produced with supporting evidence (screenshots, component tests, test user sessions) and handed to Legal
Design tokens documentation updated with migration notes for engineers and a small migration guide in the repo
QA checklist with manual test steps for NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver and keyboard-only scenarios is added to the issue
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with PM, Eng lead (R. Chen) and Accessibility consultant (inferred vendor). Agreed scope: tokens, buttons, tables, charts. Decided to target WCAG 2.1 AA as baseline and flag WCAG 2.2 items as backlog.

2026-02-18: Initial token scan completed. Found 12 color pairs failing 4.5:1 for 16px text. Created token remediation plan and mapped tokens to semantic roles (text-primary, text-muted, bg-surface, border-muted).

2026-02-26: Prototype patches for button component: added :focus-visible visible ring, explicit aria-pressed for toggle variants, aria-label required for icon-only buttons. Design reviewed; small tweaks requested by UX (outline thickness and corner radius consistency).

2026-03-02: Table accessibility doc: added keyboard navigation spec (enter to focus cell, arrow keys move between interactive cells), header cells to include scope attribute and th role. Eng raised a question re virtualized table focus – assigned ENG-1987 as dependency.

2026-03-05: Chart accessibility spike: experimented with off-screen text summary + aria-live region to announce updates. Confirmed SVGs should include role=img and aria-labelledby pointing to a visible title element. Created chart-summary pattern example in Figma and linked code example.

2026-03-09: VPAT draft template started. Collected evidence: component-level tests for Button/Table/Chart, token contrast report CSV, and two short screen-reader session recordings (VoiceOver macOS, NVDA on Windows). Uploaded artifacts to Drive: https://drive.redwood/workspace/a11y-evidence/DES-4821

2026-03-10: Design review with PM and Eng. Agreed on prioritization: 1) token fixes and icon button aria-label enforcement, 2) button focus and toggle ARIA, 3) table keyboard spec + ENG follow-up, 4) chart summaries as progressive enhancement. Updated acceptance criteria and ETA for token rollout: release ds-3.4.
qa_checks: Manual: keyboard-only walkthrough for header, nav, modal, table, form controls
Screen reader: NVDA + Chrome, VoiceOver + Safari, limited JAWS coverage in VM
Automated: axe-core run against component storybook builds, token contrast report generation
Regression: visual diff for focus rings and contrast-sensitive tokens
risks_and_open_questions: Virtualized tables: how do we preserve DOM focus order while keeping high-performance rasterization? See ENG-1987
Third-party chart lib may lack hooks for screen-readers; fallback may require wrapping with a hidden table and explicit CSV export
VPAT scope: Legal requested coverage for both hosted Console and embedded SDK surfaces — may expand effort
Timebox vs perfection: some WCAG 2.2 items (drag/drop semantics) will be logged as follow-ups instead of blocking ds-3.4
next_steps: Finish token remapping PR and land small token migration guide for engineers (owner: design) by 2026-03-20
Complete icon-only button enforcement in lint rules and update storybook examples (owner: eng) — ENG-2001
Resolve table virtualization approach with ENG-1987 and ship keyboard adapter for virtual list by 2026-03-31
Finalize VPAT draft and package evidence for Legal review by 2026-04-05
